page.layout: One column of running text, with no marginal notes on the right. Small marks and faint traces sit in the left gutter and at the bottom left, but they are not legible printed notes.

main_text.p: religis[?] Achæorum partibus Lacedæ-moniorum societati & amicitiæ se da-re velint. Quam conditionem benignitatis specie præclarè blandientem cum recusarent, profugi à Philopœmene[?] principe civitatis suæ, juvene tum primum ad famam succrescente moniti, qui dicebat, non hac mente, ut patriæ & fortunis ipsos restitueret, sed ut domum reversos simul omnes perderet, ista Cleomenem polliceri, nec se-rendos[?] esse tam nefarii consilii internuncios, actutumque iltinc[?] abire co-gendos, Cleomenes ira incensus, ac velut in furorem actus urbem Megalopolim hactenus adhuc illæsam militi diripiendam dedit, signa & tabulas pictas, quibus urbs abundabat, Spartam transferri jussit, plurimas maximasque urbis partes evertit. Tum properanter Spartam repetiit, Antigoni & Achæorum metu, quos existimabat Laconiam absente se esse invasuros. Sed cum quiescerent hi conventu agendo occupati, & militem sparsim in hybernis haberent, ipse cum audisset Antigonum cum amicis & pauculis copiis Argos profectum esse, cum exercitu suo in agrum Argolicum incurrit hoc con-silio, ut Antigonum amicorum & so-rum res uri, agi, ferri videntem & audien-

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "religis" (the g-like letter in the first word is unclear); "Philopœmene" (a mark after the word may be a dropped hyphen); "rendos" after "nec se-" (the word is not clear); "iltinc" (may be "ilinc"). Printing error left as printed: "fo-rum" at the line end, which I read as "so-rum" (long s) and kept with its hyphen. Long s has been written as plain s throughout. The bottom-left stamp and the faint marks at the left gutter are not transcribed.
